notes.title: Kana no Mado - Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where restarting a Katakana practice session at the end of the quiz would incorrectly start a Hiragana session. Restart now always resumes the same practice mode that was just completed.
[*] Improved internal mode sync on scene start to prevent rare mismatches between selected mode and displayed content.
[/list]

notes.title: Kana no Mado is now available!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674245/68b87edc38de2c56835cba3987a21ab3bbf0d9fe.png"][/img][/p][p]
Start your journey into reading Japanese with [i]Kana no Mado[/i], a calm, distraction-free app focused entirely on helping you learn hiragana and katakana – the kana characters used in everyday Japanese.[/p][p][/p][p]No grammar, no writing, no fluff – just clean, structured reading practice with native audio and instant feedback. Whether you’re a complete beginner or brushing up your kana, [i]Kana no Mado[/i] helps you go at your own pace. [/p][p][/p][h2]What’s included for free[/h2][list][*][p]Learn basic [b]hiragana[/b] and [b]katakana[/b], with native speaker audio[/p][/*][*][p]Practice voiced and combined kana (like が, ぴ, きゃ, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Test yourself with reading and listening quizzes[/p][/*][*][p]Choose between [b]3 fonts[/b]: Display, Handwritten, and Mincho-style[/p][/*][*][p]No distractions – just kana reading[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Available in English, French, Spanish, German, and Simplified Chinese[/b] [/p][p] [/p][h2]Want to go further?[/h2][p]The optional [i]Kana no Mado – Plus[/i] DLC unlocks more ways to practice: vocabulary quizzes using real Japanese words (JLPT N5-N4), smart review tracking, and extended stats.[/p][h2]
Thank you for your support[/h2][p]If you enjoy [i]Kana no Mado[/i], please leave a review to help others discover it. It really helps.
[b]ありがとうございます！[/b][/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility - Internal Testing
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674245/85408c8f68f9f823f08415db5338f9da6a5e38b9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Deck Compatibility – Tested and Working[/h2][p]
[b]Kana no Mado is not Deck Verified yet,[/b] but I want to share early details for those planning to play on Steam Deck.
[/p][list][*][p][b]Fully functional on Steam Deck and Steam Deck OLED[/b]
I have tested the app on both LCD and OLED models. Performance is smooth, with no input or display issues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full controller support[/b]
All menus and quizzes can be navigated using Steam Deck controls. The cursor is hidden, and the interface responds naturally to D-pad, analog stick, and buttons. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Native 1280x800 resolution[/b]
The app runs at the Deck’s native resolution, with crisp text and clean UI scaling. No manual adjustments needed.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]
Not Deck Verified (yet)[/b]   [/h3][p]Valve has not completed Deck verification for Kana no Mado yet. While there’s no ETA, the app is fully playable and ready for Deck users at launch.  If you experience any issues, feel free to leave feedback in the Community Hub![/p]
